gap_details.2011-2012: No roster anywhere. Wayback CDX of northshorelij.com (domain, regex neurosurg / resident) finds only NSLIJ/Faculty+Neurosurgery+Residency+at+LIJMC (Mar 2011, faculty list) and NSLIJ/Neurosurgery+Program. No Common Crawl for 2011. Not reconstructed (no earlier roster to bracket). [phase2] Reconstructed from bios (Doximity start/end years) of 2013-14 residents + Vadivelu (Doximity 2007-2012). Gapaudit 2011-2013 of northshorelij.com cushing-neuroscience-institute / NSLIJ / hospitals: only neuronews-cni-residents (2012-10, Zavarella + Vadivelu) and the training/faculty page. PubMed affiliation mining 2010-2014 surfaced Nathaniel Stetson DO (NSUH 2012; Doximity lists NSLIJ neurosurgery residency, NY licence 2009-2012, OK licence 2013) and Shawn Belverud DO (NSLIJ 2008/2010; NY licence 2010; later Navy) - pre-2011 entrants, finish year unconfirmed, not loaded.
gap_details.2012-2013: cushing-neuroscience-institute/.../neurosurgery-current-residents linked from Jun 2013 but first captured Dec 2013 (CC); /neurosurgery-residents-2012-2013 is 'Page Not Found' in every CC capture (2013-12..2014-09), never in Wayback. CC-MAIN-2012 / 2013-20 have only the training/faculty page. News item (Wayback 2012-11 / 2013-06) names residents Sal Zavarella DO and Sudhakar Vadivelu DO only. Not reconstructed. [phase2] Reconstructed as for 2011-12 plus Chakraborty/Du (Doximity 2012-2019). PGY7 (Class of 2013) group unknown - pre-2011 entrants (possibly Stetson), outside the 2011+ entry cohorts.
gap_details.2013-2014: Observed via Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2013-48 (2013-12-20); same content Mar/Apr/Jul/Sep 2014 in CC. 'Class of' headings only; PGY = 7-(class-2014). Fellow Ami Raval excluded.
gap_details.2014-2015: Observed Wayback 2014-11-13 (same in CC Oct 2014-Jul 2015). Lists Class of 2016..2021 only: no Class of 2015/PGY-7 listed (incomplete for PGY-7). DO residents' class years +1 vs 2013-14 page. [phase2] RESOLVED: the page shifted the DO residents one class late. Loven Doximity 2008-2015, Beecher at UTSW by early 2016, Januszewski Doximity 2010-2016. So Beecher/Loven = PGY7 chiefs (graduated 2015), Januszewski/Virojanapa = PGY6. Roster complete.
gap_details.2015-2016: Page never updated: neuro.northshorelij.com current-residents (Wayback 2015-09-12, 2015-11-02, 2016-04-10; CC 2015-40/48, 2016-07/18) identical to 2014-15 (no 2015 interns). Reconstructed bracketed 8 of ~14. SIGNIFICANT. [phase2] Added Januszewski/Virojanapa as PGY7 (graduated June 2016, Doximity) and 2015 interns Sun/Bonda (Doximity 2015-2022).
gap_details.2016-2017: Only content = CC-MAIN-2017-51 capture (Dec 2017) of northwell.edu .../current-residents which is stale 2016-17 content (explicit PGY labels, Pruitt/Shah PGY 1). PGY-7 class (Januszewski, Virojanapa) not listed -> incomplete. CC 2017-04 (retried) had no records. SIGNIFICANT for PGY-7. [phase2] RESOLVED: no PGY7 class existed - Januszewski/Virojanapa graduated June 2016 (Doximity; USF and Yale spine fellowships 2016-17). Roster complete.

PDF name guesses for files/2018-05..2019-04 all 404. Reconstructed 8 bracketed. SIGNIFICANT. [phase2] Gapaudit Jun 2018-Sep 2020 over professionals.northwell.edu/graduate-medical-education, www.northwell.edu/sites/northwell.edu/files, /research-and-education: only the residency main page; no roster/PDF. Added bio-confirmed PGY7 Chakraborty/Du, PGY6 Chiluwal/Gandhi, PGY1 Schneider.

adjudication_summary.note: After phase 2 every former resident resolves as a graduate (training_history rows for 15 incl. Vadivelu); 2 inferred (Shah, Unadkat).

problems: No program alumni/graduates page on any host (so no training_history rows inserted). 2011-12 and 2012-13 unobservable. Pages in 2014-15 and 2016-17 omit the PGY-7 class. DO residents (Beecher, Loven, Januszewski, Virojanapa, Gamble) were relabelled one class year later between the Dec-2013 and Nov-2014 pages, so their entry years are inconsistent (e.g. Gamble 2010 by 2013-14 labels, 2011 by later ones; adjudicator used 2010). Ross Green (Class of 2023) not on 2016-17/2017-18 class-of-2023 lists (Pruitt, Shah) but on 2020-21 at PGY-5: probable transfer-in/late addition between 2018 and 2020, not classed as joiner because 2019-20 is unobserved. Program appears to have been 1 resident/yr, 5 residents total before ~2010 ('evolving from a five-resident, one-hospital program to a full 12-resident'), 2/yr from ~2009, 2-3/yr from 2016. Common Crawl: all crawls completed (19 initially failed pairs retried successfully). residents_2011plus=36 counts Gamble as a 2010 entrant (37 if his later Class-of-2018 label is used). [phase2] Doximity gives Virojanapa residency 2011-2015 (with Northwell internship 2010-11) but fellowship 2016-17 and classmate Januszewski 2010-2016; end year recorded 2016. No Doximity/bio with years for Kevin Shah or Unadkat. Chabot Doximity profile is wrong (lists a Barrow neurology residency).
complement_note: 2/yr for 2007-2020 entrants (Class-of groups of 2), 3 in 2021, then alternating 2/3 (2022:2, 2023:3, 2024:2, 2025:3, 2026:3).

2011-2012.reason: No roster exists; all 2010/2011 entrants (Januszewski, Virojanapa, Mehan, Gamble) have bio-confirmed continuous training, both cohorts are full at the 2/yr complement; only pre-2011 finishers (Stetson, Belverud) are unplaced.

2012-2013.reason: No roster; 2012 entrants Chakraborty/Du bio-confirmed 2012-2019 (complement 2 full); only the Class-of-2013 PGY7 group (pre-2011 entrants) is unknown.

2013-2014.reason: Complete page (Class-of headings); Gamble PGY corrected to 3 from bios.

2014-2015.reason: Complete: the 'missing Class of 2015' was a mislabel; Beecher/Loven (Chief Residents) are the PGY7s (Loven Doximity 2008-2015).

2015-2016.reason: Every class bio-confirmed: PGY7 Januszewski/Virojanapa (grad 2016), 2015 interns Sun/Bonda (Doximity 2015-2022), others bracketed; no class could lose or gain anyone unseen at the 2/yr complement.

2016-2017.reason: Complete: no PGY7 class existed (the 2010 cohort Januszewski/Virojanapa graduated June 2016 per Doximity).

2018-2019.reason: PGY7/PGY6 bio-confirmed (Doximity), others bracketed; only open point: whether the 2018 class had a second PGY-1 who left after 2018-19 (Unadkat joined that class at PGY2 in July 2019 after a BWH surgery year). No trace of such a person in PubMed affiliation mining 2018-2020.

2019-2020.reason: PGY7 Chiluwal/Gandhi Doximity 2013-2020; all others bracketed (2019 interns Turpin/Toscano, Unadkat PGY2).

2021-2022.reason: Program PDF; Unadkat off roster (research year) - explained.

2022-2023.reason: PGY7 Pruitt (Doximity 2016-2023), Green (Northwell bio, chief resident), Shah (inferred, Northwell-affiliated through 2025); 2022 interns Gluski (Doximity 2022-2029)/Kashanian bracketed forward; all others bracketed.

2025-2026.reason: PGY7 Turpin/Toscano confirmed graduates (Northwell faculty bios), Unadkat inferred; 2025 interns (Donaldson Doximity 2025-2032) and all others bracketed by 2024-25 and 2026-27.
